sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. I am Emily, your host.
Today we visit Hugh, a calm and historic city in Vietnam. Hugh is known for its beautiful river, old palaces, and peaceful atmosphere.
Let's explore this special Vietnamese city together. Part two, where is Hugh?
Hugh is an essential part of Vietnam. It is close to the perfume river, a long and calm river that runs through the city.
The weather is warm, but it rains a lot in some seasons. Hugh is between mountains and the sea.
Part three, history of Hugh. Hugh was the old capital of Vietnam.
For many years, kings lived here. There were palaces, temples, and royal gardens.
The history of Hugh is very rich and important for Vietnamese culture. Part four, the Imperial city.
One of the most famous places in Hugh is the Imperial city. It is like a large old castle.
Inside, you can find gates, temples, and royal houses. The colors red and gold are everywhere. It shows the life of the kings long ago.
Part five, the perfume river. The perfume river is the heart of the city. People take boat tours on the river.
At sunset, the light is beautiful and soft. Along the river, there are parks, flowers, and walking paths.
Families and friends enjoy time together there.
Part six, food of Hugh. Food in Hugh is famous for being small, pretty, and full of flavor.
A popular dish is Bunbal Way, a spicy noodle soup. People also eat rice cakes, spring rolls, and sweet desserts.
Tea is very popular, especially lotus tea.
Part seven, pagodas and temples.
Hugh has many peaceful pagodas. The most famous one is Tian Mupagoda, a tall, beautiful tower by the river.
People come to pray, think, and enjoy the quiet place.
The sound of birds and water makes it relaxing.
Part eight, daily life in Hui. Life in Hugh is slow and calm. People ride bicycles and motorbikes.
Markets open early in the morning. Students wear white uniforms and go to school by bike.
In the evening, families eat together and enjoy fresh air outside.
Part nine, traditional clothes.
Vietnamese people sometimes wear Al Dai, a long, elegant dress.
In Hui, many women wear Al Dai for school or special days.
The dress is colorful and beautiful, showing Vietnamese culture.
Part ten, nature around Hugh. Near Hugh, you can visit beaches, mountains, and green villages.
The area is great for walking and taking photos.
You can also visit old royal tombs, surrounded by trees and lakes.
Part eleven, festivals Hugh has many traditional festivals. The Hugh festival is the biggest.
People sing, dance, and show traditional art.
Visitors come from all over Vietnam and the world.
Part twelve, why Hugh is special?
Hugh is special because it has.
Peaceful river, old palaces, beautiful temples, colorful food, calm lifestyle, friendly people.
It is a perfect city for learning about Vietnam's history and culture.
